This folder is already in the library, as “%s”.

%s does not answer. Check that the NAS is on and connected to the network.
The NAS refused access. For NFS, allow this device’s IP address on the share; for SMB, check the account’s permissions.

Enter the address of the NAS.

The folder could not be read. Try again, or check the share on the NAS.
The folder looks empty on the NAS: nothing was removed. Check that its disk is mounted; if it is empty for good, remove it.
This device has no space left: the scan stopped. Free some in Settings, Storage.
The server answered in an unexpected way. Check the address, then try again.
Nothing answers at %s. Check the address and that Jellyfin is running.
%s answers, but it doesn’t look like a Jellyfin server. Check the address and port.
Enter the address of the server, or choose one found on the network.
“%s” is not a server address. Enter its name or IP address, with its port if it isn’t Jellyfin’s.
%s answers, but its certificate is refused: expired, self-signed or made out to another name. Renew it on the server, or use its http:// address.
%1$s runs Jellyfin %2$s: Houselights needs version 10.9 or later. Update the server, then try again.
%1$s is a %2$s server: Houselights works with Jellyfin 10.9 or later.

The Zidoo player opens files straight from your NAS: best quality, no transcoding. Tell it how to turn the path seen by the server into a network path. Without a match, playback uses the HTTP stream (direct play, no transcoding either).
no match: plays the HTTP stream

Your Trakt account keeps what you watch: the films and episodes seen, and where you stopped. On this device as anywhere else.
This build of Houselights has no Trakt key.
Trakt follows your folders; it resumes when you return to them.
With a code entered on your phone or computer

Scan the QR code with your phone, or open its address on a computer, then enter this code.
Trakt doesn’t answer. Check this device’s Internet connection, then try again.
Access was refused on Trakt. Connect your account again to allow it.
The code expired before it was entered. Connect your account again for a new one.
Trakt refuses this build’s key, so the account cannot be connected.
Trakt could not complete the connection. Try again in a moment.
Trakt ended this connection. Connect your account again.
Joins what you watched here and on Trakt
Trakt doesn’t answer. What you watch will reach it once it does.
Trakt asks to wait a little. Syncing resumes on its own.
Syncing with Trakt didn’t complete. It resumes on its own.
Trakt refuses to sync: the account may be locked, or this build’s key refused. Check your account on trakt.tv.
Trakt answered in a way this version can’t read. Updating Houselights should fix it.
Trakt sends it in a form the app can’t read
Trakt sends them in a form the app can’t read
Trakt sends it in a form this version can’t read, often a paused playback left by another app. The rest is synced, and your marks go out as usual.

While the film history can’t be read in full, Houselights doesn’t send Trakt the films watched here that it lacks, so as not to create duplicates.
While the episode history can’t be read in full, Houselights doesn’t send Trakt the episodes watched here that it lacks, so as not to create duplicates.
While the film and episode histories can’t be read in full, Houselights doesn’t send Trakt the films and episodes watched here that it lacks, so as not to create duplicates.
To fix: delete it on trakt.tv, under Progress or History, or update Houselights once a version can read it.
To fix: delete them on trakt.tv, under Progress or History, or update Houselights once a version can read them.
